key_reasoning.reason: Closest pattern is the existing case-insensitive lookups in application_repository (func.lower(name) == name.lower()). The new repository query (aget_active_personal_by_creator_case_insensitive) and the PersonalProjectService guards (_is_reusable, _ensure_no_other_own_personal_variant) add edge cases: another user's personal project differing only by case, legacy duplicate case variants, shared-project conversion. These are covered by about 150 lines of new tests, but the work touches data-ownership integrity, so Technical Risk is M and not S.

Two components: ApplicationRepository (new case-insensitive query methods) and PersonalProjectService (lookup, reuse guard, event entity_id and mapping name now use the application's real name). The pattern is clear and the change is self-contained.
4 files changed (2 source, 2 test), 220 insertions and 7 deletions. Under the diffstat mapping 4-6 files is M.
